thresholds._min_earth_coverage: If less than 50% of the usable weight has Earth data, the site is 'Cannot be evaluated'.

special_rules._comment: If an Earth site has NO ground ice (ice_presence = 0), its depth-to-ice is 'not applicable' and counts as a full mismatch (similarity 0), not as missing data.

slope_240m_deg.note: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M, median within 5 km of -86.9, -4.0 (Crater centre (86.9°S, 4°W).). Elevation there: -1316 m.

roughness_240m_m.note: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M, median within 5 km of -86.9, -4.0 (Crater centre (86.9°S, 4°W).). Elevation there: -1316 m.

rock_cover_pct.note: Boulder count and density not found.

regolith_type.note: General lunar regolith; PSR soil described as highly porous.

geology_type.note: Mineral composition (rock type) not found in team docs.

cold_index.note: Target = the coldest Earth candidate. PSR temperatures (~60–80 K annual max) cannot be matched on Earth.

max_sun_elev_deg.note: 90° − 86.9° + 1.54° (lunar equator tilt to ecliptic) at the crater centre. Crater floor is mostly in permanent shadow.

ice_presence.note: UV off/on-band ratio 1.32 is above the 1.2 ice threshold (surface frost). Ice mixed in soil ~0.1–2 wt% (all cold traps combined).

ice_depth_m.note: Neutron data only senses the top ~1 m; no depth to ice reported.

logistics_index.note: Earth-only factor: target is the most accessible site.
